scope: 935 local reconstruction continuation; not the mandatory 962 workflow

phases.inputs: Original OBJ, exact arrays, frozen fine envelope, source fits and frame
phases.expected_outputs: Byte-bound inputs for a declared hypothesis

phases.inputs: Fine envelope converted to parent STL; .25 mm voxels
phases.expected_outputs: Actual STL and full shell report
phases.limitations: 29 components; 8 positive and 21 negative shells; no automatic deletion

phases.inputs: Three source-derived planes and .75 mm assumed stock
phases.runtime_commands_checks: clip_head.cpp; run_clip.py; full checks; private six-view inspection
phases.expected_outputs: Exact clipped mesh; native and rejection receipts
phases.limitations: Global low-side cut removes visible fins

phases.inputs: Unchanged parent clipped separately by each one plane; local selection plan
phases.expected_outputs: 11 local cuts, preserved fins, provenance and mesh
phases.limitations: Component identities and cap surfaces remain hypotheses

phases.inputs: Actual final aligned mesh and byte-bound admission reports
phases.expected_outputs: One closed manifold head, no final intersections, exact 3MF readback
phases.limitations: Not an analytic solid CAD master, physical fit or manufacturing proof

phases.inputs: Exact aligned NPZ and source hashes
phases.runtime_commands_checks: check_indexed_mesh.cpp; private run_remote.py; native cube/negative controls
phases.expected_outputs: Identical decompressed bytes; independent topology and volume receipt
phases.limitations: Self-intersections are checked separately on the Mac

phases.inputs: Actual local head, new outside-air grid and provisional support dimensions
phases.limitations: Axial overlap and coarse accessibility do not qualify removal or strength

phases.inputs: Actual aligned mesh and exact .05 mm planes
phases.runtime_commands_checks: slice_hypothesis.cpp; format_cli.py; validate_cli_readback.py; union_local_layers.py; complete second CLI readback
phases.expected_outputs: 2074 layers; independent all-layer union and actual file readback
phases.limitations: No hatch, exposure or machine-specific job

phases.inputs: Original exact arrays, unchanged parent and local source mesh
phases.runtime_commands_checks: assess_local_fidelity.py; 100000 samples per direction; full denominators
phases.expected_outputs: Preservation proof and unconditioned bidirectional deviations
phases.limitations: Sampling is not metrology or a global error bound; inherited closures remain

phases.inputs: New local mesh, face provenance, independently chosen wall/removal criteria
phases.runtime_commands_checks: Prepare upstream thin-feature and support-accessibility audits before mesh sweeps
phases.limitations: No minimum-wall or support-removal acceptance yet

phases.inputs: Admitted new geometry and declared mesh-purpose/feature contract
phases.runtime_commands_checks: Gmsh; independent quality, domain and convergence checks
phases.limitations: Prior envelope meshes are not this geometry; no new Gmsh solve executed

phases.inputs: Admitted flow/solid domains and explicit air/thermal boundary assumptions
phases.runtime_commands_checks: OpenFOAM; independent conservation, residual and spatial-refinement checks
phases.limitations: No measured internal geometry or engine heat balance; no new solve yet

phases.inputs: Admitted solid mesh, explicit generic material/loads and restraint hypotheses
phases.runtime_commands_checks: CalculiX; independent analytic controls, force/energy balance and convergence
phases.limitations: Interfaces, preload, contacts and material curves unqualified; no new solve yet

phases.inputs: Admitted build geometry and explicit thermal/material/process hypotheses
phases.runtime_commands_checks: Adamantine; energy/time/mesh checks and separate measured process calibration
phases.expected_outputs: Exploratory thermal study, then calibrated process comparison
phases.limitations: No accepted machine, powder, exposure or experimental calibration

phases.inputs: Measured same-specimen interfaces/internal geometry; qualified material/process; professional validation plan
phases.runtime_commands_checks: Physical print/inspection, leakage, thermal, fatigue and engine tests
phases.expected_outputs: Approved functional head and machine-specific manufacturing dossier
phases.limitations: 0/8 interfaces and 0/8 operating fields accepted; digital files do not close this phase
